RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from the information provided

An all-male panel is a reasonable concern to raise about the process, but it does not establish that sex influenced your rejection. Giving a percentage would invent precision.

Your academic credentials warrant asking how the published criteria were weighted; industry experience and interview performance could legitimately matter. Check whether a completed PhD was required and whether university policy requires panel gender balance.

Follow up now on your unanswered request, asking for assessment criteria, feedback on your application, and the panel-composition policy. Frame this as a request for transparency, not an accusation. If you suspect discrimination, promptly check local complaint deadlines with your union, an equality body, or an employment adviser.
